description: Use when the user asks about past broadband outages: how often a provider went down recently, what happened on a given day or which providers had problems lately. Returns the incidents each provider's FindBroadband page lists, current first then newest first, with when they started and were resolved, where and the provider's own words, plus a count per provider when no provider is given. For providers whose status page we can't read, days with only public reports appear as public_reports entries. Covers the last 30 days only; say so if asked about anything older. Public reports are unconfirmed.

date.description: Only incidents that touched this UK calendar day, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be within the last 30 days. Overrides days.

days.description: How many days to look back, counting today, up to 30. Leave it out for everything we hold (the last 30 days).

provider.description: Only incidents for this provider. Leave it out to search every provider we track.

name: get_outage_history

last_report_at.description: For public_reports entries: when the last public report came in. People stopped reporting problems around then; the provider never confirmed a fault or a fix.

title: Broadband outages in the last 30 days
